title: Safely inject array procedure parameters
description:
As a procedure author, I want array-valued runtime parameters to reach Lua unchanged, so that exact scoped orchestration can execute safely.

Out of scope: changing parameter semantics or adding a second execution path.

Feature: Safe structured parameter injection

  Scenario: Inject an array into a YAML-backed procedure
    Given a Tactus procedure parameter contains a JSON-compatible array
    When Plexus injects the runtime context into Lua
    Then the Lua source parses successfully
    And the procedure receives the complete array unchanged

  Scenario: Preserve scalar parameter behavior
    Given existing scalar procedure parameters
    When Plexus injects the runtime context into Lua
    Then their values remain unchanged

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added an outside-in runtime regression proving array-valued procedure parameters parse and round-trip unchanged, including Lua delimiter-like content. Replaced the ambiguous short long-string encoding with collision-safe JSON decoding. Focused regression passes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Sandbox retry exposed a second caller-side path: procedure --set retained JSON arrays as strings. Added one shared typed parser for persisted YAML values and runtime context, retaining existing scalar coercion. Array, nested-object, scalar, and malformed-input regressions pass.
